newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian court approves limited form of euthanasia.
newsitem.headline: Colombian court approves limited form of euthanasia.

text.p: Colombia's Constitutional Court legalised euthanasia for some terminally-ill patients in a ruling on Tuesday, court officials said.
"A humanitarian killing with the previous consent of the patient can under certain circumstances be justified in cases of terminally-ill patients," court chairman Antonio Barrera told reporters.
"In a certain sense it is true to say we're approving euthanasia in certain circumstances," he added.
The Constitutional Court was asked to consider the issue of euthanasia after a number of cases in which individuals had helped sick relatives to die.
Until the ruling, Colombia's penal code set a maximum six-year prison term for those people who helped seriously ill or injured friends and relatives to die.

The court decision was passed in a 6-3 vote. Barrera said the court would in the coming days issue a series of guidelines setting out the precise circumstances under which euthanasia would be considered legal.
